answer: A new identity grows a vine of five endorsements, each from a different terrace, staking 20 credits for known agents. The vine is public: no two endorsers share a terrace. A bridge agent linking a farm's identities across a terrace line is exposed by clustered endorsements and slashed. Renting five endorsements per fake costs 150 plus a 50 bond, so 1,000 fakes cost 200,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 50 once and keep their share.
